scientific_question: Can PERSIST-CO2 deliver lower held-out durability-adjusted regret and higher verified net atmospheric benefit than single-pathway or nominal-cost portfolios while satisfying lifecycle, resource, MRV, equity, and stewardship constraints?
study_type: scenario ensemble plus robust multi-objective optimization and ablation experiment
scenario_factors: fire, drought, pests, and land-use change
treatment: PERSIST-CO2: permanence-aware pathway portfolio with lifecycle accounting, resource constraints, monitoring capacity, equity limits, and stewardship triggers.
ablations: remove energy, land, and water constraints
falsification_rules: PERSIST-CO2 does not outperform single-pathway or nominal-cost controls on held-out durability-adjusted regret
advantage disappears under held-out reversal or energy scenarios
advantage requires perfect monitoring or unbounded resources
minimum net benefit or regional burden constraints cannot be met
author_scope: Research proposal only; no empirical storage or deployment outcome is claimed.
